newsitem.title: UK: TVA says to launch 1.5 bln mark 10-year bond soon.
newsitem.headline: TVA says to launch 1.5 bln mark 10-year bond soon.

text.p: The Tennessee Valley Authority will issue a 1.5 billion mark 10-year global bond soon, David Smith, its chief financial officer said on Monday.

"The launch will quite possibly take place tomorrow via Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Lehman Brothers," Smith told Reuters in a telephone interview from Frankfurt, where TVA is holding investor presentations.
"We expect the deal to come in the mid- to high-teens over German government paper," he said.
This would be TVA's first non-dollar bond offering, and is part of a strategy to broaden and diversify its investor base.
Smith said TVA hoped to pick up new investors in Asia and Japan, where the deal had been heavily marketed.
Around 30 percent of the paper was expected to be placed with German investors, he said.
TVA representatives would hold meetings with investors in Frankfurt and Japan today, and on Tuesday a delegation would come to London ahead of the launch, Smith said.
